limitations: Offline mock: token-hash vectors are not semantic embeddings.
Offline mock: extractive English only; translation and simplification require a real provider.
Offline mock: lexical sentence and section heuristics reject headings; they do not establish answer completeness.

protocol.ranking: Exact judged passage substring in original page chunks; grade 3; no partial page credit. Expansions and parent expansion disabled equally to isolate ablations.
protocol.faithfulness: Independent exact-extraction support check, not a learned semantic judge. Refusals excluded from claim denominator.
protocol.answers: Manual expected answers plus explicit keyword conjunctions; proxy for answer correctness, not a human semantic review. Negative queries require refusal.

sources.extraction: pdfjs-dist text items; coordinates approximate glyph boxes; first six original pages only; PDF not retained

tuning.objective: dev nDCG@5 then MRR@5; ties closest to k1=1.2 b=0.75
